values.heading: More than a dealership.
values.body: At Sun State International, we're more than just a dealership — we're industry experts who understand the challenges of the road. Our culture is built on accountability, action, and a commitment to doing what's right. From our parts and service teams to our finance specialists, every member of the Sun State family is dedicated to helping you succeed.

values.heading: Everything to keep you moving.
values.body: We make finding the right equipment from reputable brands easier than ever at Sun State International. Whether you need a commercial truck, trailer, or school bus, we have the equipment you need to keep your business moving.

items.title: Trucks
items.body: Shop our wide selection of new and International trucks built to handle any job, equipped with advanced telematics via OnCommand Connection for real-time fleet insights.

items.title: Trailers
items.body: Explore our diverse inventory of trailers, including flatbeds, dump trailers, and reefers, from trusted brands like Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers.

items.title: IC Bus
items.body: Built for safety and reliability, our IC Bus selection offers top-of-the-line school and commercial buses from industry-leading manufacturers.

items.title: Capacity Yard Trucks
items.body: Capacity yard trucks deliver the reliability and power your business needs to run smoothly day after day.

items.title: Service
items.body: We offer full-service repairs for trucks and trailers at our Diamond Edge certified service centers, plus mobile maintenance support so we come to you.

items.title: Parts
items.body: Order genuine parts online or in-store, with same-day pickup at our Aftermarket Parts and Truck & Trailer Parts locations.

items.title: Financing
items.body: Get financing options for your next truck or trailer purchase, with a team ready to walk you through it.

values.heading: The same trailers, every time.
values.body: At Sun State Trailers, customer service is our priority. With quality products, quick service, and dedicated care, we provide everything you need for your business to succeed. Explore our diverse selection of new and used trailers to find the equipment you're looking for.

image.alt: Sun State trailers on the lot

values.heading: Built by industry leaders.
values.body: At Sun State, we offer only the best quality for the best price — International trucks, IC Bus, and trailers from industry leaders like Hyundai Translead and Globe Trailers. When you choose a truck or trailer through Sun State, you're investing in durability, reliability, and innovation.
